title: Webhook retries stop after a day, endpoint shows disabled

posts.body: Our webhook endpoint was down over the weekend. Now it shows as disabled and new events are not delivered even though the endpoint is back up. Do we lose the events? Contact me at ops@example.org
Same thing happened to us last month.
After 24 hours of failed retries the endpoint is disabled. Re-enable it under Settings > Webhooks, then use Replay on the delivery log to resend the events from the outage window.

title: Bulk import gets 429 even with backoff

posts.body: We back off on 429 but the bulk import still gets throttled constantly. We send each record as its own request, about 400 per second from several workers.
Each worker backs off independently, so together they still exceed the per-key limit. Use the batch endpoint (up to 500 records per request) and share one rate limiter across workers.

title: Is there a way to export audit logs to our SIEM?

posts.body: Our security team wants to stream workspace audit logs into our SIEM in real time. Is there a connector or API for that?

title: SSO users get bounced back to login page

posts.body: After enforcing SAML SSO, some users get redirected back to the login page in a loop. It works for admins. The key in our config is key_ab12cd34ef56gh78 if that matters.

A login loop for non-admins usually means their email in the identity provider differs from their member email. Map the NameID or email attribute to the exact address on the member record, then have them sign in again.
